How the score works
Agreement = cases within all stated tolerances / valid measured cases. Always read it beside coverage.
This measures agreement with a chosen target. It is not a percentage of Moog authenticity or musical appeal.
Worst error / tolerance is the largest normalized error across every required measurement in that case.
Enter VALID only after the reference, all measurements, thresholds and sensitive controls are qualified.
A result needs every required measurement plus a result link. Missing evidence stays unscored.
An accepted intentional difference changes the versioned target; keep the original reference deviation visible.
First 32: 16 drum anchors, 8 mono anchors, 4 filter probes and 4 combined performances.
Expand the development set to 80. Use the 20 reserved cases at release checkpoints, not for daily tuning.
Reserve exact holdout vectors before tuning. Reusing detailed holdout feedback makes them development data.
Amber cells accept runner results. Keep raw WAVs, metric values, units, thresholds and hashes in each result.
No acoustic measurements have been imported into this workbook. The case definitions are proposed work.
Automate control gestures and sound matching first. Friends judge the remaining musical choices at the end.
Next deliverables

2. Render the integrated engine and capture the first 32 scenarios through the intended control path.
3. Qualify and cache references; import one measured baseline with per-family results.
4. Fix the largest validated reference mismatches; rerun the same cases and report regressions.
